headline: V3 Factory (Ethereum) verified and public repos confirmed; multiple recognized-firm audits including 2024 coverage; but only 1 of ~12 address-book contracts individually verified this run, BNB Chain (primary deployment) unverifiable via read API, and no commit SHA pinned
short_headline: Partial verification; audits strong but BNB unread

findings.text: PancakeV3Factory (0x0BFbCF9fa4f9C56B0F40a671Ad40E0805A091865, Ethereum) is confirmed verified on Etherscan via DeFiPunkd ABI API (abiSource='etherscan', verified=true, proxy=null). This is a non-proxy contract with a clean ABI. All other Ethereum address-book contracts (V2 Factory, Smart Router, Position Manager, Universal Router, V3 Swap Router, CAKE token) were not individually verified in this run due to permission errors on defipunkd.com/api/contract/abi for those addresses. BNB Chain contracts are outside the read API's supported chainIds and could not be checked.

Public source repos exist at github.com/pancakeswap/pancake-v3-contracts (V3 contracts) and github.com/pancakeswap/pancake-smart-contracts (general smart contracts). The docs confirm open-source software. No commit SHA was pinned in this run (GitHub pages not fetched), so source-to-deployed correspondence is not bytecode-confirmed.

The PancakeSwap audits page (fetched via docs.pancakeswap.finance) lists: PeckShield's Exchange V3 audit (Mar 2023), SlowMist's Exchange V3 audit (Mar 2023), PeckShield's MasterChef V3 audit (Apr 2023), SlowMist's MasterChef V3 audit (Mar 2023), BlockSec's veCAKE/Gauges audit (Nov 2023), and Infinity Periphery audit (2024), plus OtterSec, Zellic, and Halborn audits. The Exchange V3 audits directly cover the core AMM contracts assessed here. Individual audit PDFs were not opened this run to confirm exact commit scope.

Recognized auditors confirmed: PeckShield (listed in rubric), SlowMist, Halborn, and Zellic (all listed in rubric as broadly recognized). BlockSec is a well-known firm not explicitly on the rubric list. The combination of PeckShield + SlowMist on Exchange V3 (Mar 2023) and a 2024 Infinity Periphery audit satisfies the recognized-firm requirement for the core AMM contracts.

Exchange V3 was audited in March 2023. The Infinity Periphery audit (2024) provides more recent coverage for newer contract additions. No commit SHA was pinned to assess exact post-audit drift; the GitHub repos show ongoing activity (50 repositories, recent commits). Specific behavioral changes since the Mar 2023 audit scope are unknown without fetching the GitHub diff.

PancakeV3Factory (0x0BFbCF9fa4f9C56B0F40a671Ad40E0805A091865, Ethereum) returns proxy=null — it is not a proxy, so no separate implementation verification is required for this contract. Proxy status of other address-book contracts (Smart Router, Position Manager, etc.) was not confirmed this run.

steelman.red: BNB Chain — the primary deployment chain — has contracts (V2 Router, legacy router, V3 Factory, CAKE token) that could not be verified in this run because the DeFiPunkd read API does not support BNB Chain, and the audit PDFs were not individually opened to confirm exact deployed-commit scope.
steelman.orange: Only 1 of ~12 address-book contracts was individually verified on-chain this run (V3 Factory, Ethereum); BNB Chain contracts are outside the read API; no commit SHA was pinned to confirm source-to-deployed correspondence; and post-audit drift from the March 2023 Exchange V3 audit scope is unknown without fetching the GitHub diff.
steelman.green: The V3 Factory on Ethereum is confirmed verified with abiSource='etherscan'; public repos exist at github.com/pancakeswap (50 repos, open source); and multiple recognized-firm audits (PeckShield, SlowMist, Halborn, Zellic) cover the Exchange V3 contracts with the most recent being a 2024 Infinity Periphery audit — this is a well-audited, publicly sourced protocol.

rationale.verdict: Choosing orange because, while the V3 Factory on Ethereum is confirmed verified and recognized-firm audits (PeckShield/SlowMist Exchange V3 2023, Infinity Periphery 2024) are present, only 1 of ~12 address-book contracts was individually verified on-chain this run, the primary BNB Chain deployment is outside the read API scope, no commit SHA was pinned for source-to-deployed correspondence, and post-audit drift from the 2023 Exchange V3 scope is unquantified — satisfying the 'only some of the main contracts are verified' orange criterion.

protocol_metadata.about: PancakeSwap is a decentralized exchange (DEX) and automated market maker (AMM) enabling users to swap tokens, provide liquidity, and earn trading fees across multiple chains including BNB Chain, Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and others. It offers concentrated liquidity pools (V3), constant-product AMM pools (V2), and StableSwap pools, with liquidity providers receiving LP tokens representing their share. Users can also stake CAKE tokens in Syrup Pools and participate in yield farming, lottery, and prediction markets.
